name: How does AKN Design Group develop a cost estimate for a major renovation?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group develop a cost estimate for a major renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: We develop a comprehensive cost estimate by first understanding the full scope of your project, including design preferences, desired materials, and functional requirements. This initial consultation allows us to create a detailed scope of work. We then factor in material costs, labor for our skilled craftsmen, necessary permits, and project management overhead. Our integrated design-build approach ensures that the estimate reflects both the design vision and the construction realities, providing a transparent and comprehensive financial outlook from the outset. Understanding your priorities for aesthetics, functionality, and budget early in the process helps us align the estimate with your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group develops cost estimates by detailing the project scope, materials, labor, permits, and project management overhead to provide a comprehensive financial outlook.
